mitigations.summary: Run the GraphQL API on AWS Lambda behind Amazon API Gateway
mitigations.tradeoffs: You build, run and scale the GraphQL layer yourself; real-time subscriptions need a WebSocket endpoint.

source.quote: Lambda can be used as a compute platform to run a fully-functional GraphQL API.

mitigations.summary: Collect vehicle data with AWS IoT and AWS IoT Greengrass on Automotive Grade Linux
mitigations.tradeoffs: Signal decoding and campaigns that AWS IoT FleetWise manages become your code; check that AWS IoT and Greengrass are available in the target.

source.quote: a reference implementation that helps you integrate AWS IoT and AWS Greengrass into the AGL software stack.

mitigations.summary: Serve the content through CloudFront in the global partition with origins in AWS GovCloud (US)
mitigations.tradeoffs: The distribution and its logs live in another partition, under another account; check that this meets your compliance requirements.

source.quote: CloudFront is not available in AWS GovCloud (US), but you can use CloudFront in the standard Regions and point to your AWS GovCloud (US) resources.

mitigations.summary: Train and host forecasts with the Amazon SageMaker AI DeepAR algorithm
mitigations.tradeoffs: You prepare data, train, tune and host the model yourself; check that SageMaker AI and its built-in algorithms are available in the target.

source.quote: The Amazon SageMaker AI DeepAR forecasting algorithm is a supervised learning algorithm for forecasting scalar (one-dimensional) time series using recurrent neural networks (RNN).

mitigations.summary: Run the Apache Flink application on Amazon EMR
mitigations.tradeoffs: You size, patch and scale the cluster; Flink checkpoints and savepoints move to storage you manage.

source.quote: Amazon EMR supports Flink as a YARN application so that you can manage resources along with other applications within a cluster.

mitigations.summary: Store metrics in Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus
mitigations.tradeoffs: Covers metrics only; queries move to PromQL, and other time series need a self-managed database.

source.quote: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus is a serverless, Prometheus-compatible monitoring service for container metrics that makes it easier to securely monitor container environments at scale.

mitigations.summary: Run the pods on Amazon EKS managed node groups instead of Fargate profiles
mitigations.tradeoffs: You choose instance types and keep node AMIs current; pods no longer get a per-pod isolation boundary.

source.quote: Amazon EKS managed node groups automate the provisioning and lifecycle management of nodes (Amazon EC2 instances) for Amazon EKS Kubernetes clusters.
